name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck: orders, kitchen
promotionalText: Take pre-orders, protect your kitchen from overload and keep your service going even when the network drops. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food truck businesses: the tool your team runs its shift with.

Customers order ahead and choose their collection time. Your staff see every order on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can make, then mark the order “Ready” and “Collected”.

DON’T PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN’T KEEP
Set how much food your kitchen can make at once and how long it takes. As soon as a collection time is full, customers can’t choose it, so the queue fits the kitchen’s capacity.

TAKE ORDERS ON THE SPOT
Add walk-up orders on the same screen as pre-orders, so the kitchen works from one queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen (KDS) shows what to make now, what to make next and what is ready, and gives a reminder when it is time to start an order.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect your kitchen receipt printer over Bluetooth or the local network and order tickets print automatically.

KEEP SERVING WHEN THE NETWORK DROPS
Switch on offline protection: if the connection drops, pre-orders pause, so nobody places an order you won’t see. Orders taken on the device are saved and sync when you are back online.

MADE FOR THE FOOD TRUCK VEHICLE
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep your screen on during the shift, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app using Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and locations once and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is for food truck operators and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
